To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the top restaurants are more likely to have a higher percentage of UGC narratives that mention wine than the bottom restaurants, and that the UGC narratives of the top restaurants are significantly more likely to mention wine than those of the bottom restaurants.
the UGC narratives on TripAdvisor reveal that tourists' satisfaction experiences with fine dining restaurants are strongly influenced by the wine served.

wine plays an important part in tourist satisfaction with fine dining experiences, and the importance of wine in tourist satisfaction with a restaurant experience is positively correlated with the ranking of a restaurant.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role that wine and wine-related experiences play in the tourist experience and in customer satisfaction with restaurants
the analysis of the language used by tourists to describe their dining experiences in fine dining restaurants and the role played by wine in their satisfaction.
the role of wine in the satisfaction of customers at top and bottom ranked restaurants.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
wine plays a significant role in customer satisfaction with top ranked fine dining restaurants but a relatively minor role in customer satisfaction at bottom ranked fine dining restaurants.
there is a significant relationship between wine and tourist satisfaction with fine dining restaurant.

the analysis of the UGC data collected on TripAdvisor for the top and bottom ranked restaurants in the world reveals that wine is a significant factor in customer satisfaction with restaurants and that the role that wine can play in enhancing satisfaction is not well recognised or understood by restaurant managers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the role of wine in the satisfaction experience of fine dining restaurant customers is significant.
wine plays a significant role in customer satisfaction with restaurants.
wine is an essential ingredient for customer satisfaction with fine dinning restaurants.
The main takeaway from our work is that
wine plays a key role in the customer satisfaction experiences of tourists at fine dining restaurants.
wine plays a significant role in customer satisfaction with restaurants and that wine is a significant factor in the decision process of tourists.
the presence of wine is not a necessary condition for customer satisfaction.
